title: Validate list fields (isArray) element by element in the Amplify engine
description: The Amplify engine's Field ignores the contract's isArray, so validate_record rejects list values (e.g. [] or ["a"]) with 'must be a string'. Parse isArray and check each element (scalar and enum) in Rust and Python, with specs.
